lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg8Cr4Co4S16 (Mg2CrCoS4) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 74), with 32 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for Co, Cr, and Mg centers, each surrounded by six S neighbors, while S centers show four geometric neighbors. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 32 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner- and edge-sharing between Co and Mg octahedra, and edge-sharing among Mg octahedra.
